overview: IPv4 header fields, TTL, fragmentation (MTU, offset, MF), NAT header changes.
coreConcept: MTU se bada datagram fragments me toota hai; offset 8-byte units me hota hai.
hinglishExplanation: Data payload = MTU - header. Har fragment ka payload 8 ka multiple (last chhodkar). Fragment offset = start byte / 8. Reassembly sirf destination par. TTL har hop par kam hota hai.
formalDefinition: MTU se bada datagram fragments me toota hai; offset 8-byte units me hota hai.
importantProperties: Router TTL aur checksum badalta hai.
NAT: source IP/port aur checksum badalta hai.
